title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if a set of columns is linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. If not, they are independent.

title: Converting Units
text: Remember that height in inches is calculated as height in cm divided by $$2.54$$, and weight in pounds is weight in kg multiplied by $$2.2$$. Check if these conversions affect linear independence.

title: Checking Linear Combinations
text: Can height (in) be expressed as a linear combination of weight (lb) and bmi?

title: Span of Columns
text: Does the span of height (in), weight (lb), and bmi cover the same space as the original columns?
